ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous region covering the central 90% of the surface. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous 10-20 pixel wide border along the trailing and leading edges, with dense mottling localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 110-degree aperture angle and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 and 15 pixels, with the highest frequency of variations occurring on the inner half of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex curve trajectory from the central notch to the distal tips, following a roughly parabolic path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixels showing irregular circular geometry at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark linear pixel disruptions approximately 30-50 pixels in length located in the lower-right quadrant, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Non-uniform jaggedness and pixel discontinuities along the trailing edge margin suggesting historical material loss.
